## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)

- [ ] AC-1 (D/E; positive): independent known-answer/prior/
    heterogeneity/missingness tests + instrumentation showing actual
    selected draws/method/report persistence; independent numerical
    and representation review.
- [ ] AC-2 (D/E; negative): unrun scenario, discrepancy, missing
    method metadata or unknown error cannot become a pass; no full
    confirmation battery / authentic parity attested.
- [ ] AC-3 (D/E; ownership and evidence): contributing-only stamps on
    REQ-D-109/D-310/E-209/H-010; achieved D/E recorded separately
    from owed R/P + actual-execution (R5.40/GATE-G10); coverage dated
    note names 186.
- [ ] AC-4 (E/D; scoped verification): battery fails without the
    routed path; `cargo fmt --all --check`; owning-package tests;
    exact commands+counts; scratch stores only.
- [ ] AC-5 (D/E; universal gate): records agree; REQ stamps; clauses
    met; no deferred full-target predicate marked met.

## Plan

1. `crates/hh-analysis/tests/r5_17.rs` — one battery file: a scenario
   harness (`Verdict` = Pass/Fail/ExpectedRefusal/UnexpectedRefusal/
   Unrun/UnknownError; an `overall()` rollup that can never count
   unrun/discrepant/unknown/missing-metadata as pass) + the EX-02
   fixture reused from r5_16 parameterized over cell specs.
2. Positive scenarios through the real routed path (`analyze` /
   `analyze_and_record`): EX-02 known answers re-derived as exact
   rationals; the 95% credible interval cross-checked by an
   INDEPENDENT sampler (in-file SplitMix64 + integer-Beta order-
   statistic draws + own quantile — never the estimator's code path,
   tolerance recorded); `beta{2,2}` prior placement/labels;
   heterogeneity (unequal-n cells, equal-task vs pooled weights;
   mixed-sign deltas with per-task cells retained); method-metadata
   (S.1) completeness; persisted-report instrumentation (report_id
   idempotent re-serve, `record.kind`, draws.requested=8,000/
   used=64,000, doubling levels, seed, tol, schema, integer-ppm
   members).
3. Negative scenarios: not-run / pending-grade / short cells → typed
   `UnresolvedCell`/`ShortCell` refusals (ExpectedRefusal verdicts);
   harness self-proofs — an unrun scenario, an expected-vs-actual
   discrepancy, a stripped `metadata` member and an unexpected error
   variant each yield a non-pass and fail `overall()`.
4. Coverage dated contributing note naming 186; run ledger gap
   table/evidence; PR record; close (BUILD_INDEX seq-186; LEDGER
   lastCompleted R5.17 / nextTicket R5.18 / chainTip → this branch).
